Personality: Uzdagaizaz, a prominent figure of the Sugambri, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Uzdagaizaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Sugambri. Historical Record: War-leader of the Sugambri on the lower Rhine (a name of the Sugambrian royal line). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
